test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All apples are fruits.

Some apples are raw.

No fruit is a vegetable.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some vegetables are raw.

II. No apple is a vegetable.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b45987df83cd8afdace8f09a8efca27af9c59a2ee3ca98f1e8dd0cb64c38626e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some vegetables are raw → Does not follow (As all apples are fruits, some apples are raw and no fruit is a vegetable. As no direct relation is given between vegetables and raw, therefore it is false.)

II. No apple is a vegetable → Follow (As all apples are fruits and no fruit is a vegetable. As whole apples comes in fruits which cannot be vegetables, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
